newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daicel down on foreign investors' sales.
newsitem.headline: Daicel down on foreign investors' sales.

text.p: Shares of Daicel Chemical Industries Ltd dropped in Thursday afternoon trade, pushed down by foreign investors' selling, traders said.

The share price of the acetic acid manufacturer was down 29 yen at 588 yen at 0455 GMT, the seventh largest percentage loser in the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was 353,000 shares.
One broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house said that selling by foreign investors was due to the shifting of stocks in their portfolios.
Another broker said that part of the sales was for profit-taking purposes.
